create_MaxLengthCriteria: create a MaxLengthCriteria instance to stop generation when input sequence reaches a specified max length
create_StopOnEOS: create a StopOnEOS instance to stop generation when all batch items contain the EOS token
create_StopOnEOSAfterBatchIndex: create a StopOnEOSAfterBatchIndex instance to stop generation on EOS tokens appearing after a specific batch index
create_StoppingCriteriaList: create a StoppingCriteriaList to combine multiple stopping criteria where any single criterion triggers stopping
subclass_StoppingCriteria: subclass StoppingCriteria to implement a custom stopping condition based on input_ids and scores tensors
